name: Umi Rurika
source:
A hardcore female mangaka for H-manga. Although she is a very popular manga artist, her introverted attitude and case of androphobia causes others to see her as a useless person in society. She hardly appears in the dormitory. Rurika has taken an interest in the men recently, and that includes our protagonist, who is the young manager of the dormitory. Still worried about her dilemma, she has not taken even one step out of her room. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=815976]Getchu[/url]]
